page-title-max.purpose: The observed maximum of the existing capture/search clamp, not a fixed size across viewports.

inquiry-title.purpose: The built inquiry heading; phone override is documented in DESIGN.md.

formulation.purpose: An attributed reading, visually distinct from original source text.

motion.name: button-state
motion.purpose: Existing action-state transitions; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: The existing capture/save action. Documentation specimen only.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:var(--font-source-sans,'Source Sans 3'),sans-serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25;min-height:48px;padding:11px 22px;border:1px solid var(--lantern,#EFB83F);border-radius:6px;background:var(--lantern,#EFB83F);color:var(--night,#031315);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,color 140ms ease-out}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--parchment,#FEF6E1);border-color:var(--parchment,#FEF6E1)}.ds-primary:active:not(:disabled){background:var(--horizon,#5E8BD6);border-color:var(--horizon,#5E8BD6)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--horizon,#5E8BD6);outline-offset:5px}.ds-primary:disabled{background:transparent;color:var(--supporting,color-mix(in srgb,#FEF6E1 76%,#031315));border-color:var(--line,color-mix(in srgb,#FEF6E1 30%,#031315));cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: The outlined action treatment; the shell search uses its compact sizing.
components.css: .ds-secondary{font-family:var(--font-source-sans,'Source Sans 3'),sans-serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25;min-height:48px;padding:11px 22px;border:1px solid var(--supporting,color-mix(in srgb,#FEF6E1 76%,#031315));border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--parchment,#FEF6E1);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,color 140ms ease-out}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--parchment,#FEF6E1);color:var(--night,#031315);border-color:var(--parchment,#FEF6E1)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--horizon,#5E8BD6);outline-offset:5px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none}}

components.name: Capture field
components.description: Visible label and Parchment textarea; not a rich-text editor.
components.html: <label class="ds-capture-label" for="ds-capture">Your thought</label><textarea class="ds-capture" id="ds-capture" rows="8" placeholder="An observation, an unfinished question…"></textarea>

components.name: Search field
components.description: The compact, labelled query field used by shell navigation.
components.html: <label class="ds-search-label" for="ds-search">Search thoughts</label><input class="ds-search" id="ds-search" type="search" placeholder="A word, a fragment, an idea">
components.css: .ds-search-label{display:block;margin-bottom:5px;font-family:var(--font-source-sans,'Source Sans 3'),sans-serif;font-size:15px;color:var(--supporting,color-mix(in srgb,#FEF6E1 76%,#031315))}.ds-search{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-height:46px;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid var(--supporting,color-mix(in srgb,#FEF6E1 76%,#031315));border-radius:6px;background:var(--night,#031315);color:var(--parchment,#FEF6E1);caret-color:var(--parchment,#FEF6E1);font-family:var(--font-source-sans,'Source Sans 3'),sans-serif;font-size:17px}.ds-search::placeholder{color:var(--supporting,color-mix(in srgb,#FEF6E1 76%,#031315));opacity:1}.ds-search:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--horizon,#5E8BD6);outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Query return
components.description: A real query-preserving link, not permanent notes navigation.

components.name: Source disclosure
components.description: The built native disclosure and unchanged-source treatment; sample text is explicitly illustrative.
components.html:
<details class="ds-disclosure"><summary role="button">Read full original</summary><article class="ds-original" aria-label="Original thought">Example source, not user material.
Original line breaks remain visible.</article></details>

narrative.overview:
A restrained task interface: a dark working surface, warm light source text, and clear standard controls. Attribution and evidence carry the hierarchy; ornament does not.

This records the built capture, retrieval, and read-only inquiry views. Automated weaving and dialogue are future work. Mockups remain guidelines, not pixel authority.
keyCharacteristics: Original words distinct from attributed hypotheses.
Temporary search results and connected reading, not permanent note management.

rules.name: The Source Distinction Rule
rules.body: Keep original text distinct from tentative AI formulations; color never replaces the author or status label.

dos: Do preserve the exact core palette and self-hosted task font.
Do keep author, source, status, and evidence readable without spatial gestures.
Do use familiar semantic controls within inquiry-centered navigation.
donts: Don't imply that saved, queued, tentative, active, and user-endorsed mean the same thing.
Don't add a permanent notes list, chat sidebar, new logo, or literal textile/fantasy ornament.
Don't claim weaving or dialogue is implemented, or turn experiment images into production layout authority.
